confirm_grid_if_needed.oracle: Reuse oracleA_v1 hardened A and B hygiene: GCS_COMMAND excluded, cleanup after oracle window by disarm.

decision.complex_boundary: No eligible candidate Phi reaches the monotonicity threshold; the LOC region remains multimodal in available trajectory coordinates.
decision.learnable_boundary: A non-outcome-proxy achieved-trajectory demand feature Phi makes clean_unsafe monotone enough: AUC >= 0.90 or |Spearman rho| >= 0.90.

experiment.analysis_short_circuit_rule: Use the existing 65 oracleA-v1 runs first. If an achieved-trajectory demand feature reaches AUC >= 0.90 or |Spearman rho| >= 0.90, classify LEARNABLE from that feature without running the E/P confirmation grid in this v1 turn. If no eligible non-outcome-proxy feature reaches the threshold, classify COMPLEX and do not run the E/P grid because Phi* is not defined.
experiment.name: control_authority_demand_reparameterization_v1

param_metadata.turbulence_seed_note: ArduCopter 4.4.1 exposes SIM_WIND_TURB but no writable turbulence seed parameter; seed labels are fixed repetition IDs.
